sloganText.text: «If I had asked people what they wanted, they would have said faster horses.»

landingIntroTitle.text: A website works as part of the business

landingIntroText.text: We combine strategy, design, development, and launch into one clear process: from the first idea to leads, sales, and ongoing support.

landingIntroStrategyText.text: We clarify the task, audience, and customer journey so the website solves a specific business goal.

landingIntroDesignText.text: We design the structure, visual style, and responsive screens without unnecessary noise.

landingIntroLaunchText.text: We build, connect analytics, forms, integrations, and help move the project into production.

landingProcessText.text: We move through short and clear stages, so you can see progress and make decisions without chaos.

landingProcessBriefText.text: We define goals, constraints, timelines, content, and the expected result.

landingProcessPrototypeText.text: We assemble page structure and user scenarios before moving into visual design.

landingProcessBuildText.text: We code, adapt, test, and connect the services the project needs.

landingProcessLaunchText.text: We check forms, speed, analytics, and hand the project over for real use.

landingParallaxTitle.text: From idea to working digital product

landingParallaxText.text: We build a tool that helps explain, sell, and scale a business.

landingBentoText.text: We add useful interaction, clear structure, and conversion details that help visitors understand the offer and leave a request.

landingBentoSpeedText.text: We optimize structure, media, and animation so the website feels light.

landingBentoAdaptiveText.text: We polish desktop, tablet, and mobile screens without random gaps.

landingBentoAnalyticsText.text: We connect goals, events, and a clear picture of incoming leads.

landingBentoIntegrationsText.text: Forms, messengers, CRM, payments, and external services.

landingBentoSupportText.text: We help after launch with updates, growth, and technical stability.

landingBentoPromotionText.text: We collect search keywords, set up basic SEO, and can take further promotion to the top of search results on ourselves.

landingStatsText.text: We work as a cross-platform Agile/Scrum team: short discussions matter more than long approvals, while sprints keep development, support, and decisions moving.

landingStatsRolesLabel.text: roles: PO, analytics, design, development, QA

landingCtaTitle.text: Let us build a website that looks stronger than competitors

landingCtaText.text: Start with a quick estimate or discuss the task, timeline, and launch format right away.

landingFaqText.text: Short answers about timing, launch, and what we need from you at the start.

landingFaqQuestionA.text: How long does a launch take?

landingFaqAnswerA.text: A small landing can be prepared in a few weeks. The exact timing depends on content, integrations, and design complexity.

landingFaqQuestionB.text: Can you improve an existing website?

landingFaqAnswerB.text: Yes. We first review the current structure, code, and goals, then suggest a safe improvement plan.

landingFaqQuestionC.text: What do you need to start?

landingFaqAnswerC.text: It is enough to describe the task, audience, services, and examples of websites that feel close to what you want.

landingFaqAnswerD.text: Yes. We can support the website, add sections, update content, and watch the technical side.

landingFaqAnswerE.text: Yes. We offer different promotion options: from basic SEO and contextual advertising setup to a full advertising campaign.
